members.name: tvg_lottie_animation_tween
members.signature: Tvg_Result tvg_lottie_animation_tween(Tvg_Animation animation, float from, float to, float progress)
members.brief: Interpolates between two frames over a specified duration.
description: This method performs tweening, a process of generating intermediate frame between `from` and `to` based on the given `progress`.

params.name: animation
params.description: The Lottie animation object.

params.name: from
params.description: The start frame number of the interpolation.

params.name: to
params.description: The end frame number of the interpolation.

params.name: progress
params.description: The current progress of the interpolation (range: 0.0 to 1.0).

retvals.description: In case the animation is not loaded.

members.name: tvg_lottie_animation_tween_to
members.brief: Sets the target frame for dynamic tweening.
description: This method starts a dynamic interpolation from the current animation frame toward `to`. Use tvg_lottie_animation_tween_go() to update the interpolation progress.

params.name: animation
params.description: The Lottie animation object.

params.name: to
params.description: The target frame number of the interpolation.

retvals.description: If the animation is not loaded.

notes: The dynamic tweening set by this method is discarded when tvg_animation_set_frame() or tvg_lottie_animation_tween() is called.

members.name: tvg_lottie_animation_tween_go
members.brief: Updates the current tween toward the target frame.
description: This method advances the interpolation started by tvg_lottie_animation_tween_to() using the given `progress` value.

params.name: animation
params.description: The Lottie animation object.

params.name: progress
params.description: The current progress of the interpolation (range: 0.0 to 1.0).

retvals.description: If the animation is not loaded.
If tvg_lottie_animation_tween_to() has not been called.

members.name: tvg_lottie_animation_set_quality
members.brief: Sets the quality level for Lottie effects.
description: This function controls the rendering quality of effects like blur, shadows, etc. Lower values prioritize performance while higher values prioritize quality.

params.name: animation
params.description: The Lottie animation object.

params.name: value
params.description: The quality level (0-100). 0 represents lowest quality/best performance, 100 represents highest quality/lowest performance, the initial value is 50.

retvals.description: If the animation is not loaded.

notes: This option is used as a hint; its behavior heavily depends on the render backend.

members.name: tvg_lottie_animation_expressions_supported
members.brief: Checks whether Lottie expressions are supported.
members.returns: `true` if expression support is enabled in this build, otherwise `false`.

members.name: tvg_lottie_animation_set_audio_resolver
members.signature: Tvg_Result tvg_lottie_animation_set_audio_resolver(Tvg_Animation animation, Tvg_Audio_Resolver resolver, void* data)
members.brief: Sets the audio resolver callback for Lottie audio layers.
description: The resolver is invoked whenever the playback state of an audio layer changes. It allows applications to synchronize audio playback with the animation timeline.

params.name: animation
params.description: A Lottie animation object.

params.name: resolver
params.description: A user-defined callback that receives audio playback state updates.

params.name: data
params.description: User data passed to `resolver`.

retvals.description: The animation has not been loaded.

notes: To disable audio notifications, pass `nullptr` as `resolver`.

members.name: tvg_lottie_animation_set_volume
members.brief: Sets the master playback volume of the Lottie animation.
description: The specified volume is applied to all media assets in the animation. Each media asset preserves its own volume, and the effective playback volume is calculated by multiplying the master volume by the media asset's volume.
A value of 1.0 preserves the original volume. A value of 0.0 mutes all media. Values greater than 1.0 amplify the playback volume.

params.name: animation
params.description: A Lottie animation object.

params.name: volume
params.description: Master playback volume.

retvals.description: If the animation is not loaded.

members.name: tvg_lottie_animation_get_volume
members.brief: Retrieves the master playback volume of the Lottie animation.

params.name: animation
params.description: A Lottie animation object.

members.returns: The current master playback volume, otherwise 0 if the animation is invalid.
